forest.name: Forest
forest.rules: Tap: Add {G} to your mana pool.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.rules: Tap: Add {R} to your mana pool.

swamp.name: Swamp
swamp.rules: Tap: Add {B} to your mana pool.

island.name: Island
island.rules: Tap: Add {U} to your mana pool.

plains.name: Plains
plains.rules: Tap: Add {W} to your mana pool.

stomping_ground.name: Stomping Ground
stomping_ground.rules: Dual Land — Tap: Add {G} or {R} (Auto-tapper saves this for missing colored pips!).

wastes.name: Wastes
wastes.rules: Tap: Add {C} to your mana pool.

evolving_wilds.name: Evolving Wilds (Fetch)
evolving_wilds.rules: Fetch Land: Choose a Basic Land from your Library, put it onto the battlefield untapped, thin your deck & trigger Landfall TWICE!

llanowar_elves.name: Llanowar Elves
llanowar_elves.rules: Adds +1 {G} to your mana pool at the start of each of your turns.

lotus_cobra.name: Lotus Cobra
lotus_cobra.rules: Landfall: Whenever a Land enters, add +1 Any-Color Treasure Mana & +1 Resonance.

scute_swarm.name: Scute Swarm
scute_swarm.rules: Haste. Landfall: Create a 1/1 Haste Insect token (or clone Scute Swarm if you control 4+ Lands!).

cultivate.name: Cultivate
cultivate.rules: Choose a Basic Land from your Library and put it onto the battlefield untapped (triggers Landfall!).

rampaging_baloths.name: Rampaging Baloths
rampaging_baloths.rules: Trample, Haste. Landfall: Create a 4/4 Beast token with Trample.

briarback_colossus.name: Briarback Colossus
briarback_colossus.rules: Trample. Landfall: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

overrun.name: Overrun
overrun.rules: All Creatures you control gain +3/+3 and Trample until end of turn, plus +2 Resonance!

colossal_dreadmaw.name: Colossal Dreadmaw
colossal_dreadmaw.rules: Trample, Haste. Excess damage dealt to blockers hits the Boss!

monastery_swiftspear.name: Monastery Swiftspear
monastery_swiftspear.rules: Haste. Prowess: Gains +2/+2 and +1 Resonance whenever you cast an Instant or Sorcery.

emberline_daredevil.name: Emberline Daredevil
emberline_daredevil.rules: Haste. Prowess: Gets +2/+2 and gains +1 Resonance whenever you cast an Instant or Sorcery.

furnace_arc.name: Furnace Arc
furnace_arc.rules: Deal 3 Burn damage to the Boss and gain +1 Resonance.

goblin_guide.name: Goblin Guide
goblin_guide.rules: Haste. Ready to attack the turn it enters.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.rules: Destroy target Enemy Blocker (or deal 4 Base Burn Damage to Boss) and gain +1 Resonance.

krenkos_command.name: Krenko's Command
krenkos_command.rules: Create two 1/1 Red Goblin Creature tokens with Haste.

goblin_rabblemaster.name: Goblin Rabblemaster
goblin_rabblemaster.rules: Haste. ETB: Create a 1/1 Haste Goblin token and give all your Goblins +1/+1.

seething_song.name: Seething Song (Ritual)
seething_song.rules: Add {R}{R}{R}{R} to your mana pool and gain +2 Resonance this turn!

temur_battle_rage.name: Temur Battle Rage
temur_battle_rage.rules: Target Creature gains Double Strike (2× Power) and Trample this turn!

terror_of_the_peaks.name: Terror of the Peaks
terror_of_the_peaks.rules: Flying, Haste. ETB: Deal 5 Burn Damage and gain +2 Resonance.

vampire_nighthawk.name: Vampire Nighthawk
vampire_nighthawk.rules: Flying, Deathtouch, Lifelink. Heals you and kills any blocker with 1 damage!

dark_ritual.name: Dark Ritual
dark_ritual.rules: Add {B}{B}{B} to your mana pool and +1 Resonance this turn.

ashen_bargain.name: Ashen Bargain
ashen_bargain.rules: Pay 2 Life: Draw 2 cards and gain +1 Resonance. You must have more than 2 Life to cast this.

village_rites.name: Village Rites
village_rites.rules: Sacrifice 1 of your weakest Creatures (if any): Draw 2 cards and gain +2 Resonance!

reanimate.name: Reanimate
reanimate.rules: Return a Creature from your Graveyard to the Battlefield with Haste (or spawn a 3/3 Haste Fiend if empty)!

archon_of_cruelty.name: Archon of Cruelty
archon_of_cruelty.rules: Flying, Lifelink, Haste. ETB: Destroy an Enemy Blocker, Draw 1 card, and gain +2 Resonance.

delver_of_secrets.name: Aberrant Delver
delver_of_secrets.rules: Flying, Haste, Prowess. Gains +2/+2 and +1 Resonance whenever you cast an Instant or Sorcery.

unsummon.name: Vapor Snag (Bounce)
unsummon.rules: Tempo Bounce: Return target Enemy Blocker to the Æther, draw 1 card, and gain +1 Resonance.

ledger_shredder.name: Ledger Shredder
ledger_shredder.rules: Flying, Haste. Connive: Whenever you cast your 2nd+ Spell in a turn, gains +2/+2 permanently, draws 1 card, and adds +1 Resonance.

frost_breath.name: Cryptic Freeze
frost_breath.rules: Freeze up to 2 Enemy Blockers (they cannot block or retaliate this turn!), draw 1 card, and gain +2 Resonance.

tideglass_sentry.name: Tideglass Sentry
tideglass_sentry.rules: Flying. ETB: Freeze the strongest Enemy Blocker this turn and draw 1 card.

slipstream_reversal.name: Slipstream Reversal
slipstream_reversal.rules: Return target Enemy Blocker to its owner's hand and gain +2 Resonance.

brainstorm.name: Expressive Iteration
brainstorm.rules: Draw 2 cards from your deck, add +1 Any-Color Treasure Mana, and gain +1 Resonance.

tempest_djinn.name: Tempest Djinn
tempest_djinn.rules: Flying, Haste. ETB: Bounce an Enemy Blocker and gain +2 Resonance (+1 extra Power per Blue/Dual Land you control)!

esper_sentinel.name: Esper Sentinel
esper_sentinel.rules: Lifelink. At the start of each of your turns, draw 1 extra card and gain +1 Resonance.

swords_to_plowshares.name: Swords to Plowshares
swords_to_plowshares.rules: Exile target Enemy Blocker, heal 3 Life, and gain +1 Resonance.

ajani_pridemate.name: Ajani's Pridemate
ajani_pridemate.rules: Lifelink, Haste. Whenever you gain Life, permanently put +2/+2 on Ajani's Pridemate and gain +1 Resonance!

unbreakable_formation.name: Unbreakable Formation
unbreakable_formation.rules: Anthem: Permanently put +2/+2 on ALL Creatures you control, heal 3 Life, and gain +2 Resonance!

heroic_reinforcements.name: Heroic Reinforcements
heroic_reinforcements.rules: Create two 1/1 White Soldier tokens with Haste, then all your Creatures gain +2/+2 and Haste this turn (+2 Resonance)!

dawnbell_acolyte.name: Dawnbell Acolyte
dawnbell_acolyte.rules: Lifelink. ETB: Heal 2 Life and gain +1 Resonance.

sunlit_rally.name: Sunlit Rally
sunlit_rally.rules: Create two 1/1 White Soldier tokens with Haste and gain +1 Resonance.

serra_angel.name: Serra Angel
serra_angel.rules: Flying, Lifelink, Haste. ETB: Heal 4 Life and gain +2 Resonance.

sun_titan.name: Sun Titan
sun_titan.rules: Trample, Haste. ETB: Return a Creature or Land from your Graveyard to the Battlefield and gain +2 Resonance!

stitchers_supplier.name: Stitcher's Supplier
stitchers_supplier.rules: Haste. ETB: Mill 3 cards from your Library into your Graveyard and gain +1 Resonance!

satyr_wayfinder.name: Satyr Wayfinder
satyr_wayfinder.rules: Haste. ETB: Mill 3 cards into your Graveyard, return a Land from your Graveyard to your Hand, and gain +1 Resonance!

mosswake_forager.name: Mosswake Forager
mosswake_forager.rules: ETB: Mill 2 cards, return a Land from your Graveyard to your Hand, and gain +1 Resonance.

grisly_salvage.name: Grisly Salvage
grisly_salvage.rules: Mill 3 cards into your Graveyard, return the strongest Creature from your Graveyard to your Hand (or draw 1), and gain +2 Resonance!

fiend_artisan.name: Fiend Artisan
fiend_artisan.rules: Trample, Haste. Undergrowth ETB: Permanently gains +1/+1 for each Creature card in your Graveyard and +1 Resonance!

izoni_undergrowth.name: Spider Spawning
izoni_undergrowth.rules: Undergrowth: Create a 2/2 Green Spider token with Haste & Lifelink for each Creature in your Graveyard (min 2, max 5) and gain +2 Resonance!

floodplain_cartographer.name: Floodplain Cartographer
floodplain_cartographer.rules: Landfall: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you draw a card.

vault_skirge.name: Vault Skirge
vault_skirge.rules: Flying, Lifelink, Haste. Swift metallic construct that drains life from above.

steel_overseer.name: Steel Overseer
steel_overseer.rules: ETB & Start of Turn: Permanently put +1/+1 on ALL Creatures you control and gain +1 Resonance!

arcbound_ravager.name: Arcbound Ravager
arcbound_ravager.rules: Trample, Haste. Modular ETB: Permanently gains +1/+1 for each other Creature you control and +1 Resonance!

thoughtcast.name: Thoughtcast
thoughtcast.rules: Affinity Draw: Draw 2 cards and gain +1 Resonance.

thopter_foundry.name: Thopter Foundry
thopter_foundry.rules: Create two 1/1 Colorless Thopter Construct tokens with Flying & Haste, heal 2 Life, and gain +1 Resonance.

galvanic_blast.name: Galvanic Blast
galvanic_blast.rules: Metalcraft: Destroy target Enemy Blocker (or deal 5 Burn Damage to the Boss if no Blockers) and gain +1 Resonance!

cyberdrive_awakener.name: Cyberdrive Awakener
cyberdrive_awakener.rules: Overdrive: All Creatures you control gain +3/+3, Flying, and Haste this turn, plus +2 Resonance!

myr_battlesphere.name: Myr Battlesphere
myr_battlesphere.rules: Trample, Haste. ETB: Create three 1/1 Colorless Myr Construct tokens with Haste and gain +2 Resonance!
